display.purpose: Page titles and only the most important measured values.

headline.purpose: Major evidence blocks and section headings.

label.purpose: Fields, badges, captions, and secondary metadata.

shadows.name: mobile-navigation
shadows.purpose: Lifts the fixed bottom navigation from the canvas.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Button state changes; all transitions are removed for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Starts a consequential workspace action such as training.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 18px; border: 1px solid #0066d9; border-radius: 24px; background: #0066d9; color: #fff; font: 500 15px Roboto, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .16s ease, color .16s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0054b4; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0074d9; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #dcecff; color: #273b4a; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Uses a quiet bordered surface for supporting actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 18px; border: 1px solid #dbe3e9; border-radius: 24px; background: #fff; color: #273b4a; font: 500 15px Roboto, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .16s ease, color .16s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #edf5ff; border-color: #99bddf; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0074d9; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Evidence Field
components.description: Native control styling for experiment configuration and record selection.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; color: #1c2228; font: 500 12px Roboto, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field select { min-height: 46px; padding: 9px 12px; border: 1px solid #9dacb8; border-radius: 12px; background: #f7f9fc; color: #243a4b; font: 400 15px Roboto, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field select:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0074d9; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Cohort Card
components.description: Shows a hospital cohort with a dedicated, non-evaluative tonal surface.
components.css: .ds-cohort { display: grid; gap: 14px; padding: 24px; border-radius: 28px; background: #edf5ff; color: #163b62; font: 400 15px Roboto, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-cohort strong { font-size: 17px; } .ds-cohort span { font-size: 38px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-cohort small { font-size: 11px; } .ds-bar { height: 7px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 8px; background: #b8cbdc; } .ds-bar i { display: block; width: 62%; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: #397baf; }

components.name: Metric Tabs
components.description: Pill selector for AUROC, accuracy, and F1 comparisons.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 30px; background: #f0f4f8; } .ds-tabs button { min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 24px; background: transparent; color: #1c2228; font: 500 12px Roboto, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tabs .ds-active { background: #fff; color: #005bbb; box-shadow: 0 2px 7px #273c4b12; } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0074d9; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Mobile Pill Navigation
components.description: Fixed compact navigation used under the tablet breakpoint.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; padding: 6px; border: 1px solid #dbe5ec; border-radius: 40px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 8px 30px #1f354726; } .ds-nav button { min-height: 46px; padding: 10px 13px; border: 0; border-radius: 24px; background: transparent; color: #1c2228; font: 500 12px Roboto, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav .ds-active { background: #e7f1ff; color: #005bbb; } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0074d9; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Privacy Evidence Panel
components.description: Dark evidence surface for measured privacy–utility tradeoffs.
components.html:
Measured privacy–utility tradeoff

Comparable experiments only.
components.css: .ds-privacy { padding: 26px; border-radius: 24px; background: #131b21; color: #f5f9fc; font: 400 15px Roboto, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-privacy h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 18px; } .ds-privacy p { margin: 0 0 16px; color: #b4c7d1; font-size: 12px; } .ds-privacy svg { width: 100%; } .ds-privacy path { stroke: #7d929d; fill: none; } .ds-privacy circle { fill: #67d8d0; stroke: #d1fffb; stroke-width: 2; }

narrative.overview: The interface makes complex consent and privacy evidence feel like a calm, readable workspace. White surfaces and generous breathing room establish the baseline; cool blue, mint, and apricot separate the three hospital cohorts without turning their data into decoration. The blue-teal sculpture and the dark privacy chart are reserved evidence landmarks. They give the research view a recognizable focal point while measured values, consent status, and limitations stay in ordinary readable UI.
keyCharacteristics: Spacious white cards on a pale blue-grey canvas.
Rounded controls and cohort-specific tonal panels.
Blue for primary action, teal for consent-aware context, and a dark panel for privacy evidence.

rules.name: The Cohort Separation Rule
rules.body: Use blue, mint, and apricot to distinguish the three existing hospital cohorts; do not use them to imply performance or consent quality.

rules.name: The Evidence First Rule
rules.body: Large type belongs to measured values and page purpose; decorative type does not compete with research evidence.

rules.name: The Space for Evidence Rule
rules.body: Let dense tables scroll horizontally inside their own container; do not compress columns until values become hard to compare.

rules.name: The Tonal Layer Rule
rules.body: Prefer a white or tinted surface change over a shadow; elevation is reserved for floating or selected controls.

dos: Do keep controls native and expose clear keyboard focus.
Do use the three cohort surfaces consistently for Hospital A, B, and C.
Do reserve the dark privacy panel for privacy evidence and comparative measurement.
Do use actual experiment, consent, and accountant values in visual summaries.
donts: Don't add extra display fonts or icon libraries; the shipped system uses Roboto, Consolas, and inline or bundled SVG assets.
Don't rely on shadows to make ordinary cards feel layered.
Don't turn cohort colors into a claim about hospital quality, privacy, or clinical outcome.
